استغللن (form X)
# اِسْتَغْلَلْنَ (istaḡlalna) /is.taɣ.lal.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَغَلَّ (istaḡalla)
# اُسْتُغْلِلْنَ (ustuḡlilna) /us.tuɣ.lil.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَغَلَّ (istaḡalla)
# اِسْتَغْلِلْنَ (istaḡlilna) /is.taɣ.lil.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَغَلَّ (istaḡalla)
